description.value:
All warriors have their weapons of choice. While most adventurers rely on general proficiency to survive, you refused to stop there. With enough practice, you’ve begun to unlock your weapon’s hidden potential.

Fighters who become savvy with a weapon gain bonuses that surpass proficiency and open new ways to wield that type of weapon.

Pick three weapons with which you are already proficient. You become Savvy with these weapons. So long as you are wielding a savvy weapon, you gain the relevant weapon effects from the table below. In addition, you gain a +1 to Attack Rolls with your Savvy weapons.

Learning New Savvies: You learn 1 additional savvy at each Growth Level.





Savvy Effects: While using the weapon of choice that you are Savvy with, you gain the following benefits.

Savvy Effect Table

Weapon

Effect

Axes (Hatchets, Battleaxes, or Greataxes)

Guillotine Strike (Passive): Your attacks deal 1d12 extra damage to @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.RK3DF56CKMQUV6DM]{Prone} creatures. If the attack kills a humanoid, it can behead the creature.


Deforestation (Passive): Your attacks deal an additional 1d8 slashing damage to plants. Additionally, wooden objects and structures take double damage from your attacks.

Blowgun

First Strike (Passive): Attacks made with this weapon while hidden are made at Advantage.


Tranquilizer (Passive): Attacks with this weapon deal an additional 1d6 poison damage, and the creature must make a Constitution (Save) check against a DC of 15 or be @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.9X088PM7H5U2S1HQ]{Sickened} for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

Bludgeons (Clubs, Greatclubs, Hammers, or Knuckles)

Concussion (Passive): When you land a critical hit, you can instead choose to forgo the extra critical hit damage in order to apply the @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.PEDR1J13VZXKUF3C]{Stunned} condition to the target until the end of its next turn.


Bell Ringer (Minor Action): As a minor action, your next attack with this weapon this turn causes the target to also make a Constitution (Save) check of DC 10 + Strength Modifier, causing the target to be @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.LM1J0T2XZ0KS1UFK]{Muddled} and @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.3BAHKVP3ZKFC7BJD]{Staggered} on failure until the end of its turn.

Bows (Shortbows or Longbows)

Suppression (Action): As an action, you can expend 5 ammunition to suppress all targets within a 15ft cone until your next turn with a flurry of shots in the area. Suppressed targets get disadvantage on attack rolls while in the area, and if they move while under suppression then you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against them. If you take a desperate action before your next turn then suppression ends.


Arrow Curving (Passive): Your attack rolls are unaffected by half-cover, three-quarters cover, or the target being @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.RK3DF56CKMQUV6DM]{Prone}.

Crossbows (Light, Hand, Heavy, or Repeating Crossbows)

Stock Bash (Minor Action): Your crossbow can be used as a 1d4 bludgeoning melee weapon as a minor action. If you hit a creature with this melee attack, you automatically Disengage from that target and have advantage on attacking them with your crossbow on this turn.

Dagger

Slit the Throat (Passive): You deal 1d10 extra damage to @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.FGVFFYGPAFQGZ5RP]{Grappled}, @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.3CQC3JEY2C3Y721F]{Incapacitated}, or @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.1EK5V6KTYAWC6S69]{Restrained} creatures.

Dart

Pinpoint (Passive): Your proficiency bonus is doubled for attack rolls with this weapon.


Anchoring Shot (Minor Action): As a minor action, your next dart attack this turn becomes an Anchoring Shot. If this attack hits a flying, swimming, or riding creature, then the target must make a Dexterity (Save) check of DC 10 + your Strength Modifier.

On failure:

  • The flying creature falls 10ft and repeats the check until it hits something or succeeds the save.
  • The swimming creature falls 10ft.
  • The riding creature is dismounted and falls @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.RK3DF56CKMQUV6DM]{Prone}.

Hooked Blades (Scythe or Sickle)

Reap (Attack): Once per turn in place of an attack, you can attack two creatures within reach and within 5ft of each other.


Sow (Minor Action): As a minor action, you wind your weapon back to prepare to reap. The next time you use Reap this turn, you can target any two creatures within reach.


Nick (Passive): When you miss an attack, deal 1 slashing damage to the target.

Maces (Maces or Flails)

Internal Injury (Passive): When you attack a @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.RK3DF56CKMQUV6DM]{Prone} creature, it takes an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage and it must make a Constitution (Save) check of DC 8 + your Strength modifier. On failure, the creature takes 1d6 extra chaos damage at the beginning of its next turn.

Morning Star

Aerate (Passive): When you land an attack, the target must make a Constitution (Save) check of DC 8 + your attack modifier. On failure, the creature gains 2 @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.R54LQEKSDXNQ3N75]{Bleeding}.

Pickaxe

Pierce (Passive): When targeting creatures with natural armor or wearing armor, add an amount equal to your proficiency bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. This bonus is added after normal proficiency bonuses are added.

Pike

Hold Position (Reaction): While in Self-Defense, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack on a creature that moves into or within your attack range. If the attack hits, you regain your reaction and Hold Position ends.

Polearms (Glaive or Lance)

Vault (Minor Action): As a minor action, you can plant and push off of your weapon to launch yourself higher, increasing your jump height or distance by +10ft.


Riding Weapons (Passive): Attacks against non-mounted creatures while on a mount have a +3 to hit, and deal an additional 1d6 force damage.


Anti-Riding Weapons (Passive): Attacks against mounted creatures are made at advantage.

Quarterstaff

Sweep the Leg (Minor Action): As a minor action, take the Trip action.


Follow Down (Reaction): When a creature within weapon range falls @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.RK3DF56CKMQUV6DM]{Prone}, you can make an opportunity attack against them.

Rapier

Have At Thee! (Desperate Action): If you use a desperate action before your first turn in combat, you can both move and make an attack action. The first attack made this way deals 3d4 extra piercing damage.


Lunge (Passive): You can add 5ft of range to one attack per turn.


Feint Retreat (Passive): You can disengage as a non-action after landing an attack on a target.

Shields, One-Handed (Shields or Bucklers)

Uncanny Block (Desperate Action): When a creature that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use a desperate action to reduce the attack’s damage against you by half.

Shields, Two-Handed (Tower Shields)

Iron Wall (Desperate Action): When you make a Dexterity (Save) check to take half or full damage, you can use your desperate action to protect yourself. If you are holding your shield in two hands, then you can also protect one other creature within 5ft of you. Protected creatures take half damage when they would take full damage, and take no damage if they would take half damage.

Slings (Slings or Slingshots)

Cluster Shot (Attack): In place of an attack, you can attack a single target twice at disadvantage.

Spears (Javelins, Spears, or Tridents)

Pierce Pin (Minor Action): As a minor action, the target of your next attack with this weapon this turn must make a Dexterity (Save) check of DC 8 + your Dexterity Modifier on hit. On failure, they become @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.FGVFFYGPAFQGZ5RP]{Grappled} until the end of their next turn as some part of them is pinned to the environment. On success, they become @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.3BAHKVP3ZKFC7BJD]{Staggered} instead. If the target is adjacent to a wall or static object on the opposite side of them from your attack, the save DC increases by +5. Large or larger creatures become staggered on failure and gain no condition on success.


Water Weapon (Passive): Attack and damage rolls are not negatively affected by being used in or under water.

Swords (Shortswords, Midswords, Greatswords, or Scimitars)

Lock Weapons (Passive): When you miss with a melee weapon attack against a creature of equal size who is wielding a weapon or staff, you can attempt to lock weapons with that target. The target must make a Strength (Save) against DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength Modifier. On failure, you two lock your weapons together. While weapon locked, you are both @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.3BAHKVP3ZKFC7BJD]{Staggered}, and your locked weapons are unusable for anything other than making attacks against each other.
If either of you ends the weapon lock, then the other can make an opportunity attack against them. The following will end a weapon lock:

  • Taking an action other than attacking each other.
  • Leaving melee range of each other.
  • Choosing to drop the weapon lock as a non-action.

Anbinden (Action): As an action, attack and purposefully miss the target, such that you can activate Lock Weapons.

Throwing Star

Silent Killer (Passive): While hidden, attacks with this weapon deal an additional 1d8 damage and the result of your previous Dexterity (Stealth) roll decreases by -2. This may reveal your location if your stealth becomes lower than a creature’s Awareness.

Unarmed

Pushy (Minor Action): As a minor action, take the shove action.


Environmental Takedown (Passive): When you succeed on a shove action, pick one structure or other creature within 5ft of you to shove the creature into. Depending on the target, you get one of the following results: 

  • Structure: You smash the creature into a wall, large object, or structure. The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to your unarmed attack damage. The structure takes equal damage.
  • Creature: You grab and slam one creature into another, giving both creatures bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength Modifier.

War Hammers (Mauls or Warhammers)

Ground Slam (Minor Action): As a minor action, all creatures within 5ft of you must make a Dexterity (Save) check of DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength Modifier. On failure, the creature falls @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.RK3DF56CKMQUV6DM]{Prone}.


Deconstruct (Passive): Your attacks deal an additional 1d10 bludgeoning damage to constructs. Attacks do double damage to structures and stone objects.

Whips (Whips or Chain Whips)

Seize (Reaction): You can attempt to @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.FGVFFYGPAFQGZ5RP]{Grappled} targets in place of your opportunity attack. Grapples made in this way add your proficiency bonus to the result of the grapple check, on top of any Strength (Athletics) bonus.

system.requirements: Must have the Fighter Starter Abilities
